All intervals, half-open rule and authored annotation status are available and task-aligned.
Boundary release/attack/hold split and missing seventh explanation explicitly elicited.
All event/snapshot/shared-B counts are elicited and independently recomputed.
All beat conversions and scales are elicited; corrected numeric-copy qualification is taught in every locale.
Exact-export data and executed-evidence boundary explicitly elicited without asserting observed runtime failure.
All placements and pitch-class content are elicited; fixture order differs explicitly from GA internal order.
Three separate melody predicates explicitly elicited; each candidate membership recomputed.
D string-order counterexample is explicitly elicited and arithmetically correct.
Positions, penalties and hard-before-soft selection explicitly elicited; physical claims withheld.
Empty exact-register result, authored candidates, failed probe and unmeasured comfort explicitly elicited.

first_api_official_links.basis: First tab-solver/type/tuning mentions link to the official pinned GA repository; first MusicXML mention links to W3C. Official URL HTTP statuses are supplied readback evidence, not new network observations.

locale_scope.review_kind: AI semantic comparison; no fluent human approval
locale_scope.details: All nine maintain constructed-fixture, exact-register, authored harmony, source-only and failed-live-probe boundaries; MusicXML divisions scale and numeric-copy correction appear in EN/FR/ES.

distinctness.MUS023: Adds fixed registered two-voice endpoint, complete path totals, changed destination and per-state DP distinction to MUS005 guide-tone/nearest-note exercise.
distinctness.MUS024: Adds identified half-open events, attacks versus sounding snapshots, independent harmonic annotations and explicit representation/export unit boundary to MUS004 duration/tie/groove vocabulary.
distinctness.MUS025: Adds exact highest-registered-pitch predicate before a separately declared soft position penalty; string-order counterexample and empty feasible set.

scope_limits: AI factual/source-assisted audit only; not a formal CE shipping review or human approval.
No network, builds, installs, Git mutations or repository edits.
Only external receipt written; all course/support files read-only.
GA Git blobs inspected at exact pinned commit; official MusicXML page content not independently fetched or byte-validated in this audit; supplied HTTP readback receipts retained.
No GA solver/candidate execution, physical objective measurement, score conversion, audio, player trial or learner outcome.
Source and fixture audit does not validate rendered pages, deployment or the complete university goal.
Receipt binds only inspected sources and support; no not-ready validation/build files are bound.
